profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Accessibility and Performance
profile.summary:
Full Stack Developer passionate about building scalable and high-performance web applications. With over five years of experience, I specialize in technologies like Next.js, React, TypeScript, and PHP. I thrive on continuous learning and leveraging cutting-edge tools to deliver innovative solutions.

I take ownership of my projects and believe in empowering teams to make informed decisions. My approach focuses on understanding user needs and pursuing excellence to create functional and delightful solutions.

Experienced in leading projects from concept to production, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality and performant products. Committed to improving processes, mentoring developers, and driving accessibility initiatives.

Advocate for diversity, inclusion, and equity, both in and out of the workplace. Outside of coding, I enjoy running, hiking, and reading, and I'm passionate about giving back to the community.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained full-stack web applications for small businesses and startups, delivering responsive, accessible interfaces with React, TypeScript, and Vue.
- Designed RESTful APIs and integrated third-party services (Shopify, payment gateways, CRM platforms) to streamline client operations and data flow.
- Provisioned and managed cloud infrastructure on AWS and DigitalOcean, including EC2 deployment, S3 storage, and Cloudflare WAF configuration.
- Conducted WCAG 2.2 accessibility audits and remediation for client websites, ensuring compliance and improved user experience.
- Collaborated directly with stakeholders to scope projects, estimate timelines, and ship features from concept to production.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer and Accessibility Lead
positions.description:
At Kinetic, I have served as a Full Stack Developer specializing in creating accessible and high-performance web applications. My role has involved a diverse set of technologies including WordPress, React, TypeScript, and Vue, allowing me to build dynamic and responsive user interfaces.

Key responsibilities and achievements:
- Accessibility Leadership: I have led multiple initiatives to improve accessibility, ensuring compliance with WCAG 2.2 and Section 508 standards. This includes rewriting internal documentation and implementing solutions that enhance usability for all users.
- Full-Stack Development: Utilizing technologies like React, Vue, and Tailwind for front-end development, and TypeScript for type-safe JavaScript, I have built scalable and maintainable applications. My work in WordPress has involved creating custom themes and plugins that extend functionality and improve user experiences.
- Project Management: I take ownership of projects from concept to completion, collaborating with designers, marketing teams, and stakeholders to deliver solutions that meet business objectives and user needs.
- Mentorship and Collaboration: I've mentored junior developers and fostered a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement. By conducting code reviews and providing actionable feedback, I've helped ensure that our projects adhere to best practices and accessibility standards.
- Performance Optimization: I've focused on optimizing application performance, ensuring fast load times and smooth interactions, which are critical for user satisfaction and engagement.

At Kinetic, I have been committed to leveraging technology, including AI, to create inclusive digital experiences. My work not only addresses technical challenges but also aims to make a positive impact on users by ensuring accessibility and performance.

projects.title: Save the City (with water!)
projects.description: Save the City (with water!) is a game that I created together with a team formed on the spot during the 48-hour Clickteam Full Sail Game Jam 2014. For this Game Jam we had to create a game using the Clickteam Fusion 2.5 engine, and follow theme that was set for this Game Jam which was "Just add water". In this game you fly around in a helicopter trying to extinguish fires in a procedurally generated map. My primary responsibility working with both the engineer and artist to make sure we had all the materials needed. I was involved with fine-tuning of game mechanics that included the water and fire contact radius. I heavily playtested the game with both members in order to find the best balance of fun and difficulty. Additionally I did the menu layouts using art supplied by our artist to ensure a professional feel to the project.
